name: A Lesson in Divinity
label: Quest
description: A Lesson in Divinity: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, you want to... Help? Why would an adventurer want to help a beggar like me?
Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.

It's my wife you see. She, well... She's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is very kind of you, adventurer. Very kind indeed.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
